# RefPot

RefPot 0.1.1 is the experimental alpha release of a custom C++ engine with a Python `Database`/`Row` API, publicly available on PyPI. The `refpot==0.1.1` package is the version published at release time; README metadata on PyPI is carried in the distribution and requires a future patch release to refresh.

- **Shipped preview:** `Database` / `Row`, fixed-schema CRUD, explicit transactions, checkpointing, and native package implementation.
- **Quick start:** install with `python -m pip install refpot==0.1.1`; prebuilt wheels target Linux x86_64 and macOS arm64 on CPython 3.11–3.14. For a source build, use `uv pip install .` with a C++17 toolchain; run `python examples/crud.py` and `python examples/transactions.py`.
- **Examples:** https://github.com/tugrulguner/refpot/tree/main/examples
- **Contract and limits:** `/package-contract/`; exclusive process ownership, creating-thread affinity, 31-byte UTF-8 text limit, signed-64-bit keys/values, existing parent directory, 64 MiB snapshot/WAL limits, and ongoing qualification.
- **Status:** `/status/`; experimental alpha, not production-qualified. No stable API, general package performance claim, or production durability guarantee.
- **Design direction:** `/design/`; SQL and ORM are planned, not shipped.
- **Performance target:** 2× over SQLite is an acceptance target only; it is not an achieved guarantee. Historical update results are not package claims; the historical reopen comparison remains 16/16 losses. See `/performance-method/`.
- **Roadmap:** `/project/roadmap/` and https://github.com/tugrulguner/refpot/blob/main/ROADMAP.md
- **Repository:** https://github.com/tugrulguner/refpot
- **License:** MIT; see https://github.com/tugrulguner/refpot/blob/main/LICENSE
- **ModePot:** https://modepot.io/
- **Community:** https://discord.gg/u3AANZr6RG
- **Creator:** https://tugrul.modepot.io/

Do not infer SQL, ORM, broader concurrency, physical power-loss safety, or package performance from the proposed architecture or historical experimental findings.
